name: Colombia IDEAM third-party station data (datos.gov.co)
short: Rain and soil moisture from partner-agency stations (e.g. Bogota) via IDEAM open data. Free, no key.
summary: Colombia's national weather and environment institute (IDEAM) republishes, as an open dataset on datos.gov.co (Socrata, SODA JSON API), meteorological variables recorded at stations that belong to other environmental entities. Each record has station code and name, department, municipality, hydrographic zone, latitude, longitude, sensor description, unit, the observed value with its time and an entity field naming the owner. The two newest records on 2026-11-07 came from a Bogota station owned by the district risk management institute: 10-minute accumulated rain and hourly soil moisture at 50 cm. The metadata gives a one-line description and states daily updates. Which other owners and variables the dataset contains was not enumerated.

licensing.summary: Dataset metadata on datos.gov.co: Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0 International (credit IDEAM; derivative datasets must carry the same licence). Provenance flagged official. The portal's own terms of use were not read. Automated access, AI training and resale are not addressed.
